title: Accept worker turns by checks the driver runs
body: Outcome: independent acceptance after a worker turn: `--require <path>` (missing from the turn's changes → exit 4 even on `done`), and the driver runs declared `--check <cmd>` / `--observer <file>` itself after the turn (non-zero → exit 4); report consistency (changed_paths vs diff, canary, `done` with a non-zero check) refused; `krn verify` fails instead of skipping red-first when code changed without an observer (src/verify/index.ts:557). Source: .krn/runs/lead/worker-audit/code-audit.md fixes 2-5. Proof: observers required-outputs, acceptance-checks, report-consistency, verify red-first-required, each red at base by assertion.
